description: Industry-specific design vocabulary for creative provocation and concept generation. Used by the MCP to inject industry-native metaphors and section concepts into the agent's creative brief.

section_concepts.about: Mission briefing document — split layout with organization seal/insignia on one side, briefing text on the other, key personnel listed like crew assignments with role designations
section_concepts.team: Crew assignments board — personnel displayed like a mission crew roster with role designations, clearance levels, and mission patches. Photography dominant with data overlays
section_concepts.pricing: Launch configuration panel — tiers presented like vehicle configurations with payload capacity, orbit options, and mission parameters. Technical, not commercial
section_concepts.cta: Launch sequence — final call-to-action styled like a mission go/no-go decision panel with status checks and a prominent launch button
section_concepts.testimonials: Mission logs — client quotes styled as after-action reports or mission debrief entries with dates, mission codes, and outcomes
